Kind regards,
Linda

messages.body_plain:
I'm attempting to run MSStats Group Comparison via the Skyline plugin, and it is failing with:
2> =======================================
2> ** Data Processing for analysis.....
2>
2> Input missing peaks was checked!
2>Error in dataProcess(raw, normalization = inputnormalize, nameStandards = standardpepname,  :
2>  unused arguments (nameStandards = standardpepname, fillIncompleteRows = (inputmissingpeaks == "TRUE"))
2>Error in quantData$GROUP_ORIGINAL :
2>  $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors
2>
2> Can't finish analysis.

>From my searching, this seems to indicate a problem with the input file. Given that the input file is being generated on-the-fly by Skyline, troubleshooting this bug is difficult.
I was wondering if there was a way to export the Skyline-generated MSStats input file for manual examination?

Best,
Jason

messages.subject: required R version
messages.body_plain:
Dear MSstats developer,

I would like to draw your attention to the following:

When installing MSstats as an external tool in Skyline a specific R version is required. In the absence of this spec. R version the installation of MSstats fails. Unfortunately, I am running skyline on a computing cluster for performance reasons (working with DIA data on a normal labtop is no fun!) without being able to install a specific R version.

Is there are workaround? Is this strict dependence really necessary? I guess many more people will use Skyline on servers in the future and run into similar problems!!!

Thx,
Tobi

messages.subject: Re: required R version
messages.body_plain:
Dear Tobi,

Thank you so much for your feedback.

MSstats external tool installs R 3.0.3 and MSstats needs >=R 3.0 because ‘MSnbase’, one of required packages, requires >=R 3.0. So if you had the higher than R 3.0.x, MSstats functions will work.

As you mentioned, now we fix the required R version 3.0.3, which means that R 3.0.3 version is needed even though other version of R is already installed in the computer. We start to work for this issue with Skyline team. We will fix this issue in next version of MSstats external tool.

Thank you again,

--Meena
